description: One structured artifact per test run, per docs/TESTING_FRAMEWORK.md section 5. A consumer must reject an unknown major schema_version rather than guess.

detail.description: Required for skip (why the case could not run) and for fail (what happened).

replay.description: Seeded inputs sufficient to reproduce the case: seed plus tick-stamped inputs for games, navigation steps for app-shell cases.

screenshots.description: Screenshot files stored with the artifact. Every UI test attaches one on failure, plus one success screenshot at the key state.

videos.description: Video files stored with the artifact. Simulator video is kept only when a case fails or the run was dispatched with video requested; physical video is imported per docs/TESTING_FRAMEWORK.md section 5.4.

ir_hash.description: Required when the case exercises a game; makes the failure replayable.

run_id.description: Unique per run; the correlation key for logs and telemetry.

title: test-feedback
